result.topic_en: A worked numerical example (case 2) of computing the plane coordinates of Estebrügge from three known stations (Hamburg, Horneburg, Stade) with a correction step solving for small unknowns η and φ, followed by a remark on a simplified variant of the method.

methods.what: Numerical determination of the plane coordinates (x, y) of a point from three known stations with their azimuths (resection-type computation, case 2), with a linear correction for small unknowns η and φ
Modified formulas for the auxiliary quantities l, l', l'' that save a logarithm

items.quote:
Man kann die obige Methode auch dahin abändern
daß man $l=\frac{r''}{\cos t}(\theta''-\theta')$, $l'=\frac{r'}{\cos t'}(\theta-\theta'')$, $l''=\frac{r''}{\cos t''}(\theta'-\theta)$
setzt, wodurch noch wenigstens ein Logarithm erspart wird.
items.english: One can also modify the above method by setting l = r''/cos t (θ''−θ'), l' = r'/cos t' (θ−θ''), l'' = r''/cos t'' (θ'−θ), whereby at least one more logarithm is saved.
